lines.text: Did you know? Spect is Latin for look.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus look?

words.ex: Restaurants are regularly inspected for hygiene.
We should treat everyone with respect.
We expect about fifty guests at the wedding.

publish.title: Spect root: inspect, respect and expect
publish.value: Spect comes from Latin "specere" (to look). Words: inspect, respect and expect. inspect = in + spect; respect = re + spect; expect = ex + pect.
